- Salary of €15,60 per hour

- Extra shift allowances

- Travel allowance of €0,14 per kilometer

To keep the warehouse running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a warehouse worker:

- You’re available at least 2 days a week
- You can work in both day shifts and evening shifts
- You speak Dutch or English

You’ll also help out in other departments. For example loading and unloading trucks. Since Kwantum sells all kinds of products, from furniture to little candles, the work can vary quite a bit in how heavy it is. 💪

Where will you work
Not only the Kwantum furniture pieces are super cozy and comfy. The work atmosphere is too! You’ll work in a small team where everyone is equal. Whether you’re a warehouse worker or a team leader!

When you start working at Kwantum, you’ll get a proper onboarding period with personal guidance. So you’ll feel at home quickly! ✨

We are regularly looking for enthusiastic logistics staff who are eager to roll up their sleeves and get to work. In this role, you may be assigned to various departments, and your responsibilities will include receiving, inspecting, and preparing products for shipment. Outbound Operations: What does your workday look like as an order picker or packer? You ensure that orders are prepared for shipment. As an order picker, you do this by filling boxes with the correct products. These boxes come your way on a conveyor belt. Using a handheld scanner, you scan the pick list and fill the box with the correct products from inventory. As a packer, you’re responsible for getting the order ready for shipment; you fill the box and attach a shipping label to it. Then you place the box back on the conveyor belt and move on to the next one!
